entities.name: Emir Mutapčić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emir "Meho" Mutapčić is a Bosnian professional basketball coach and former player. He most recently worked as the head coach for Zalaegerszeg of the Hungarian league. Mutapčić competed for Yugoslavia in the 1984 Summer Olympics. He was the Israeli Premier League Assists Leader in 1990.
